conventions: Add the Backstage Apache 2.0 license header with Copyright 2026 The Backstage Authors on newly created source and migration files only; keep existing copyright headers on edited files unchanged.
Format all TypeScript, JavaScript, YAML, and Markdown files with Prettier (2-space indentation, single quotes, trailing commas, 80-col wrap).
Tag all new symbols exported from @backstage/catalog-model and @backstage/catalog-client with @public JSDoc comments so API Extractor reports succeed without warnings.
In frontend tests, prefer screen and findBy* queries from @testing-library/react over waitFor, and do not introduce any data-testid attributes.

Follow docs/contribute/doc-style-guide.md for documentation edits and use minor semver bumps across all five affected packages (@backstage/catalog-model, @backstage/catalog-client, @backstage/plugin-catalog-backend, @backstage/plugin-catalog, @backstage/plugin-techdocs) in five separate changeset files, each with a message about its own package only.

decisions.choice: Export ANNOTATION_PREVIOUS_NAMES = 'backstage.io/previous-names' from packages/catalog-model/src/entity/constants.ts and parseEntityPreviousNames(entity: Entity): string[] from packages/catalog-model/src/entity/ref.ts (re-exported via entity/index.ts and package root).
rejected: Inline parsing separately inside catalog-backend and catalog-client
decisions.reason: Sharing the parser in @backstage/catalog-model ensures identical comma-splitting, trimming, defaultKind: entity.kind, defaultNamespace: entity.metadata.namespace || DEFAULT_NAMESPACE, same-kind validation, self-ref filtering, and deduplication across performStitching and InMemoryCatalogClient.

decisions.topic: Database schema for previous entity names
decisions.choice: Create table final_entity_previous_names in migration 20261104000000_previous_entity_names.js with entity_id (notNullable, FK to final_entities.entity_id ON DELETE CASCADE) and previous_entity_ref (notNullable), unique constraint final_entity_previous_names_entity_id_ref_uniq on (entity_id, previous_entity_ref), index final_entity_previous_names_entity_id_idx on entity_id, and index final_entity_previous_names_previous_entity_ref_idx on previous_entity_ref.
rejected: Querying the search table on relations/annotations at read time
Modifying entitiesBatch or normal entity lookup queries
decisions.reason: Isolates former-name storage to a dedicated indexed table tied to stitched final_entities via ON DELETE CASCADE and keeps entitiesBatch and existing query shapes in queries.md completely untouched (AC-5).

decisions.topic: Redirect resolution and permission filtering in DefaultEntitiesCatalog and AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog
decisions.choice: Add entityRedirect?(request: EntityRedirectRequest): Promise<EntityRedirectResponse | undefined> to EntitiesCatalog with filter?: FilterPredicate; DefaultEntitiesCatalog normalizes the requested entityRef, returns undefined if a stitched live entity exists in final_entities for that ref, queries final_entity_previous_names joined with final_entities (applying request.filter via applyEntityFilterToQuery as entitiesBatch does), and returns { entityRef } only when exactly one stitched authorized entity matches; AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog reads (await this.permissionApi.authorizeConditional(...))[0] and builds the FilterPredicate via this.permissionPredicate.
rejected: Returning one of multiple matching entities arbitrarily
Typing EntityRedirectRequest.filter as legacy EntityFilter instead of FilterPredicate
decisions.reason: Matches EntitiesBatchRequest.filter and AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog.entitiesBatch while guaranteeing live entity precedence (AC-3), 404 on ambiguous multi-claimants (AC-3), and permission enforcement on redirect targets (FR-6, AC-4).

decisions.choice: Declare getEntityRedirectByRef?(entityRef: string | CompoundEntityRef, options?: CatalogRequestOptions): Promise<CatalogEntityRedirect | undefined> as an optional method on the CatalogApi interface while implementing it concretely on CatalogClient and InMemoryCatalogClient.
decisions.reason: Keeps existing CatalogApi mocks outside the write allowlist (such as plugins/catalog-react/src/testUtils/catalogApiMock.ts) assignable to CatalogApi under yarn tsc while providing full implementations on CatalogClient and InMemoryCatalogClient.

decisions.topic: Frontend redirect notifications and route preservation in Catalog and TechDocs
decisions.choice: In useEntityFromUrl (Catalog), preserve useRouteRefParams, useAsyncRetry with refresh, and the errorApi guard for missing name, adding the redirect lookup inside a try/catch only after getEntityByRef misses (falling back to the not-found state on redirect lookup errors) and hiding the entity only while a redirect is pending; in useExternalRedirect (TechDocs), use useLocation() and useParams() to preserve sub-path, query string, and hash when getEntityByRef misses, posting a transient info alert via useApiHolder().get(alertApiRef)?.post(...) and navigating with { replace: true }.
rejected: Replacing useAsyncRetry with useAsync in useEntityFromUrl or letting getEntityRedirectByRef errors prevent the not-found fallback
decisions.reason: Preserves the existing refresh and not-found fallback behavior in useEntityFromUrl, uses standard react-router-dom hooks, and satisfies FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13, AC-7, and AC-8.
